games.title: Arena Shooter
games.tag: online multiplayer · first person · up to 8
games.desc: First-person drop-in deathmatch in a generated arena. WASD + mouse look, Space jump, RMB zoom, R reload, Shift sprint, C crouch — crouching also shrinks your hitbox. Q raises an off-hand shield that doesn't just block a bullet, it reflects it back at the shooter. Jump onto the low crates and fight from up there; the tall containers stay hard cover. Grab glowing pads to upgrade your pistol. Textured basalt arena, an animated SWAT operator, Blender-built viewmodel with hands. E is a melee strike that kills outright and goes straight through a raised shield — the counter to someone turtling behind Q. Headshots kill outright too, so aim high.

games.title: Fire Racer
games.desc: Arcade racing through a gothic castle bailey — a 920 m circuit with a main straight, a long sweeper, a fountain chicane and a hairpin. WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake to break traction and drift, Shift to spend one of three boost charges. Practice alone, or open a lobby and race other people on an authoritative server.

games.title: what is this?
games.tag: local diagnostic · browser + hardware · optional upload
games.desc: A playful, staged answer to a practical question: what kind of machine and browser is this? Runs fixed wasm CPU and timing kernels, records floating-point and feature fingerprints, and keeps going when a probe is unavailable. The complete JSON report can stay on your device; sending it to the Ember server is a separate, explicit choice.
